# Skills index

Curated, portable Agent Skills for coding assistants. Each folder contains a `SKILL.md`
with YAML frontmatter and optional `references/`, `scripts/`, and `evals/`.

## Product and decisions

- feature-interrogation — challenge a feature before building it.
- acceptance-criteria — turn a vague request into a testable contract.
- simplest-solution — the least code and dependencies that solve the problem.

## Engineering quality

- code-review — find real defects in a diff, ranked by severity.
- debug-root-cause — reproduce, isolate, and fix the cause.
- refactor-safely — behavior-preserving structural change.
- test-strategy — risk-based decisions about what to test and where.
- security-review — threat model and concrete security audit.
- performance-engineering — measure, profile, fix, and guard the bottleneck.

## Data and APIs

- migration-safety — expand/contract migrations without downtime or data loss.
- api-contract — design and evolve APIs clients can depend on.

## Craft and design

- anti-ai-slop — remove generic, templated, AI-looking output.
- clear-writing — docs, errors, PRs, and microcopy that are specific and useful.
- pr-craft — reviewable, reversible commits and pull requests.
- accessibility-audit — WCAG 2.2 AA audit and fixes.
- design-system-discipline — tokens, primitives, variants, and migration.
- motion-quality — purposeful, accessible, performant animation.
- image-to-ui — pixel-level reproduction of a UI from a screenshot or mockup.
- tasteful-ui-ux — design direction and full UI/UX engagements.
- frontend-polish — visual and UX polish without regressions.

## Delivery and operations

- observability-first — logs, metrics, traces, SLOs, and alerts built in.
- release-readiness — evidence-based go/no-go and post-deploy verification.
- dependency-hygiene — add, update, or remove dependencies deliberately.

## Meta

- skill-template — starting point for a new skill.
